company.name: Be Free Tours
company.tagline: Your Rio, Your Way - Private Tours and Local Experiences Since 2013
company.description: Premium Rio de Janeiro operator offering two product lines: private guided tours and local immersive experiences with certified local guides

private_tours.label: Private Tours
private_tours.description: Fully guided private tours focused on Rio landmarks, day trips, and efficient logistics.

experiences.label: Local Experiences
experiences.description: Guided walking-based, cultural, food, and community experiences for travelers seeking deeper local immersion.

booking.policy: Free cancellation up to 72 hours (3 days) before the tour start time

city_tours.label: City Tours
city_tours.description: Private city tours covering Rio icons, culture, and neighborhoods with skip-the-line access.

faqs.question: Are city tours private?
faqs.answer: Yes. All tours are private and tailored to your group.

faqs.question: Do you include skip-the-line access?
faqs.answer: Yes for key attractions like Sugarloaf and strategic timing for Christ.

tours.id: The Essential Rio: Icons, Culture & Hidden Gems
tours.name: The Essential Rio: Icons, Culture & Hidden Gems
tours.description: Full-day private tour of Rio covering Christ the Redeemer, Sugarloaf Mountain, Santa Teresa and downtown. Licensed guide and separate driver. Tickets included, with skip-the-line cable car access at Sugarloaf.
highlights: Christ the Redeemer, tickets booked in advance for your preferred boarding time
Sugarloaf Mountain with skip-the-line cable car tickets
Santa Teresa and the Selarón Steps
Metropolitan Cathedral and Royal Portuguese Reading Room (weekdays only)
Licensed tour guide and separate professional driver
Fully customizable itinerary, private to your group

tours.id: Rio Express: Christ & Sugarloaf in 5 Hours
tours.name: Rio Express: Christ & Sugarloaf in 5 Hours
tours.description: Five-hour private tour of Christ the Redeemer and Sugarloaf Mountain. Licensed guide and separate driver, tickets arranged in advance, skip-the-line cable car access at Sugarloaf. Pickup at Pier Mauá for cruise passengers.
highlights: Christ the Redeemer, tickets booked in advance for your preferred boarding time
Sugarloaf Mountain with skip-the-line cable car tickets
Licensed tour guide and separate professional driver
Pickup at Pier Mauá cruise terminal, hotels or airports
Return planned around your ship's official all-aboard time

tours.id: Rio at First Light: Sunrise Sugarloaf & Christ
tours.name: Rio at First Light: Sunrise Sugarloaf & Christ
tours.description: Experience Rio's most breathtaking sunrise from Sugarloaf Mountain, followed by early access to Christ the Redeemer.
highlights: Sunrise from the Sugarloaf summit, before the crowds
Early morning Christ the Redeemer visit
Professional photography opportunities

tours.id: Golden Hour Rio: Christ & Sugarloaf at Sunset
tours.name: Golden Hour Rio: Christ & Sugarloaf at Sunset
tours.description: Experience Rio's golden hour beauty with afternoon visits to Christ the Redeemer and a perfectly timed sunset from Sugarloaf Mountain.
highlights: Christ the Redeemer in golden light
You choose where you watch the sunset — Christ the Redeemer or Sugarloaf
Sunset from Sugarloaf summit
Panoramic beach views
Professional photography guidance

tours.id: Sunset & Culture: Rio Icons + Roxy Brazilian Dance Show
tours.name: Sunset & Culture: Rio Icons + Roxy Brazilian Dance Show
tours.description: Private afternoon-to-evening tour of Christ the Redeemer and Sugarloaf Mountain at sunset, followed by dinner and a Brazilian cultural show at the Roxy. Available Wednesday to Sunday; the Roxy show ticket is non-refundable.
highlights: Christ the Redeemer
Sugarloaf Mountain at sunset
Roxy Brazilian dinner show
Three-course dinner at the Roxy

tours.id: Tijuca Rainforest: Where Nature Meets Culture
tours.name: Tijuca Rainforest: Where Nature Meets Culture
tours.description: Combine Sugarloaf Mountain's stunning vistas with the lush beauty of Tijuca Forest and Botanical Garden.
highlights: Sugarloaf Mountain
Tijuca Forest - vast urban rainforest
Botanical Garden
Parque Lage

tours.id: Niterói: Niemeyer's MAC Museum & Colonial Forts
tours.name: Niterói: Niemeyer's MAC Museum & Colonial Forts
tours.description: Cross Guanabara Bay to discover Niterói's architectural masterpiece MAC Museum and historic military forts.
highlights: MAC Niterói by Oscar Niemeyer
Historic military forts
Spectacular Rio skyline views
Oceanfront lunch location

tours.id: Modern Rio: Museum of Tomorrow & Samba School Behind the Scenes
tours.name: Modern Rio: Museum of Tomorrow & Samba School Behind the Scenes
tours.description: Explore Rio's innovative Museum of Tomorrow, South America's largest aquarium, and go behind the scenes of Carnival.
highlights: Museum of Tomorrow
AquaRio aquarium
National Historical Museum
Carnival samba school behind-the-scenes

tours.id: Your Rio, Your Way: Custom Private Tour
tours.name: Your Rio, Your Way: Custom Private Tour
tours.description: Can't find exactly what you're looking for? Design your own Rio experience. Tell us your interests, and we'll craft a personalized itinerary just for you.
highlights: 100% customizable itinerary based on your interests
Expert local guide who adapts to your pace and style
Combine any attractions, neighborhoods, or experiences
Flexible duration from half-day to multi-day adventures
Perfect for special occasions, unique interests, or accessibility needs
We handle all logistics, tickets, and reservations

day_trips.label: Day Trips
day_trips.description: Full-day escapes to beaches, islands, and mountain towns outside Rio.

faqs.question: How far are day trips from Rio?
faqs.answer: Most destinations are 2-3 hours each way.

faqs.question: Are meals included?
faqs.answer: Meals are typically not included unless specified.

tours.id: Island Escape: Ilha Grande by Private Speedboat
tours.name: Island Escape: Ilha Grande by Private Speedboat
tours.description: Private day trip from Rio to Ilha Grande by speedboat, exploring sheltered beaches and snorkeling spots with a licensed guide, a driver and a sailor. Standard experience focuses on calm, shallow-water beaches; a premium option adds Lopes Mendes, reached via Praia do Pouso and a forest trail. About 10 to 12 hours door to door.
highlights: Private speedboat exclusively for your group
Sheltered beaches with clear, shallow water
Snorkeling equipment included at no extra cost
Lopes Mendes as a premium option
Licensed guide throughout the day, plus driver and sailor

tours.name: Petrópolis: Imperial Palaces & Mountain Escape
tours.description: Escape to the mountains and explore Brazil's imperial history in Petrópolis, the summer residence of Brazilian emperors.
highlights: Quitandinha Palace
Imperial Museum with crown jewels
House of 7 Errors
Metropolitan Cathedral
European-style town center

tours.name: Búzios Day Trip from Rio
tours.description: A private day trip to Búzios, the chic beach town on the coast east of Rio, known for its many beaches and the cobblestoned Rua das Pedras waterfront. Arranged on request and tailored to your dates; an optional boat trip to see the beaches from the water can be added.
highlights: Private day trip tailored to your dates
Búzios beaches and the Rua das Pedras waterfront
Certified guide and private transport from Rio
Optional boat trip to see the beaches from the water

experiences.label: Local Experiences
experiences.description: Immersive guided experiences in Rio focused on food, heritage, and community connection.

faqs.question: Are experiences private?
faqs.answer: Yes. Experiences are guide-led and organized for private parties.

faqs.question: How are experiences different from private tours?
faqs.answer: Experiences are more walking-based and culturally immersive, while private tours focus more on landmark coverage and logistics.

items.name: Rio Food Walking Tour
items.description: Taste classic Brazilian flavors with a local guide on a private food walk through one of Rio's most vibrant neighborhoods.

items.name: Little Africa Walking Tour
items.description: Discover the places, memory, and resistance that helped shape Rio's Afro-Brazilian heritage on a private walk through Little Africa.

items.name: Downtown Rio on Foot: Selarón Steps & Hidden Gems
items.description: Discover downtown Rio's architectural treasures, historic squares, and the iconic Selarón Steps on a private guided walk.

items.name: Santa Teresa Walking Tour: Art, History & Hidden Corners
items.description: Explore one of Rio's most atmospheric neighborhoods on foot, uncovering art, history, and local life off the main tourist trail.
